stateProfile.name: Uttar Pradesh
stateProfile.judicialCapital: Prayagraj (High Court of Judicature at Allahabad)
stateProfile.area: 240,928 sq km (7.33% of India's total geographical area, 4th largest state)
stateProfile.populationCensus2011: 199,812,341 (16.51% of India's population, highest in India)
stateProfile.neighborDetails: 8 States (Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Bihar) + 1 UT (Delhi) + 1 International Boundary (Nepal)

stateSymbols.emblem: A circle containing a bow and arrow (symbol of Lord Rama) and two fishes (symbol of Awadh Nawabs) surrounded by waves representing Ganga-Yamuna

rivers.name: Ganga
rivers.tributaries: Yamuna, Ramganga, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Son, Tons

rivers.name: Gomti
rivers.origin: Fulhar Jheel (Gomat Taal) in Pilibhit district
rivers.specialFact: Originates from a plains lake rather than the Himalayas

rivers.name: Betwa
rivers.dams: Matatila Dam, Rajghat Dam, Parichha Dam

nationalParksAndSanctuaries.name: Dudhwa National Park
nationalParksAndSanctuaries.significance: Only National Park in Uttar Pradesh; famous for Swamp Deer (Barasingha), Tigers, and One-horned Rhinos.

nationalParksAndSanctuaries.name: Pilibhit Tiger Reserve
nationalParksAndSanctuaries.significance: Awarded the international TX2 award for doubling tiger population ahead of target.

nationalParksAndSanctuaries.name: Ranipur Tiger Reserve
nationalParksAndSanctuaries.type: 4th Tiger Reserve of UP (53rd in India)

nationalParksAndSanctuaries.name: Amanagarh Tiger Reserve
nationalParksAndSanctuaries.significance: Buffer zone of Corbett National Park located within UP.

nationalParksAndSanctuaries.name: Chandraprabha Wildlife Sanctuary
nationalParksAndSanctuaries.significance: First wildlife sanctuary established in UP (1957).

nationalParksAndSanctuaries.name: Bakhira Bird Sanctuary
nationalParksAndSanctuaries.significance: Notified as a Ramsar site; wintering ground for migratory birds.

nationalParksAndSanctuaries.name: Nawabganj (Shahid Chandra Shekhar Azad) Bird Sanctuary
nationalParksAndSanctuaries.significance: First bird sanctuary of Uttar Pradesh (1984).

expresswaysAndInfrastructure.name: Purvanchal Expressway
expresswaysAndInfrastructure.features: Air strip at Kurebhar (Sultanpur) for emergency fighter aircraft landing

expresswaysAndInfrastructure.name: Bundelkhand Expressway
expresswaysAndInfrastructure.route: Gonda village (Chitrakoot) to Kudrail (Etawah, merges with Agra-Lucknow Expressway)

interactiveMapPoints.name: Lucknow
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Capital of UP, Rumi Darwaza, Asafi Imambara, Chikankari craft hub

interactiveMapPoints.name: Prayagraj
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Sangam of Ganga, Yamuna & mythical Saraswati; Kumbh Mela; High Court

interactiveMapPoints.name: Varanasi
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Ancient living city on the banks of Ganga; Kashi Vishwanath; Sarnath nearby

interactiveMapPoints.name: Ayodhya
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Birthplace of Lord Rama; Sarayu river; historical capital of Kosala

interactiveMapPoints.name: Agra
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri; founded by Sikandar Lodi in 1504

interactiveMapPoints.name: Kanpur
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Manchester of the East; leather hub; IIT Kanpur; 1857 Revolt epicentre

interactiveMapPoints.name: Meerut
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Starting point of 1857 First War of Independence on 10 May 1857; sports goods hub

interactiveMapPoints.name: Gorakhpur
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Gorakhnath Temple; Gita Press (Centenary Year); Rapti river

interactiveMapPoints.name: Dudhwa NP
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Only National Park in UP in Lakhimpur Kheri; Swamp Deer (Barasingha)

interactiveMapPoints.name: Jhansi
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Gateway to Bundelkhand; historic fort of Rani Lakshmibai (1857 hero)

interactiveMapPoints.name: Sonbhadra
interactiveMapPoints.fact: Energy capital of India (Singrauli/Rihand Dam); borders 4 states (MP, CG, JH, BR)
